title: Eval harness: add prompt-regression CI hook and metrics adapter
author: Asha Patel
description: Add a GitHub Actions CI hook and a lightweight eval-metrics adapter to gate PRs on prompt-set regressions and make eval metrics usable in CI. Motivation: authors frequently introduce changes that regress generated output quality for specific prompt-sets; catching regressions earlier reduces rollbacks and manual eval work. This PR introduces: 1) .github/workflows/eval-regression.yml - new CI hook that runs the eval-harness against a curated prompt-set for changed models/routes and fails the job if defined metric deltas exceed configured thresholds; 2) tools/eval_metrics_adapter.py - small service script that pulls per-prompt metrics from the eval harness run, normalizes them to the gating schema, and writes a gating-report.json used by the CI job; 3) eval/thresholds/prompt_gates.yaml - repository-level gating thresholds with per-metric delta tolerances and opt-in/opt-out entries; 4) docs/eval/ci-gating.md - docs on how to add prompt-sets, interpret gating reports, and override gates for experimental work. Implementation notes: the CI job runs in a lightweight container with cached model artifacts; the eval harness is executed with --ci-mode to produce deterministic seeds and compact JSON outputs; the adapter computes rolling-window baselines when historical data is available and falls back to the baseline commit when not. The gating logic supports per-prompt and aggregate rules and emits an annotated GitHub check with per-metric deltas and links to the full eval artifact. Checklist: - [x] implement GitHub Action and adapter - [x] add thresholds file and defaults - [x] add docs and runbook for triage - [x] add unit and integration tests for the adapter - [x] smoke test on a small prompt-set in CI Followups: integrate the adapter with the metrics service to persist historical baselines (ENG-4988) and add a per-team override flow in the console. Backwards compatibility: default thresholds are conservative and this hook is enabled only for repositories configured in eval/thresholds/repo_allowlist. Rollout: staged to redwood repo first, then SDK repos after one week of stable runs.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice direction. Two asks: (1) make sure the action is resilient to transient infra issues (retries/backoff), (2) surface per-prompt breakdown in the check output so reviewers can triage quickly.
Asha Patel (author): Added retry/backoff to the action and added a per-prompt breakdown section in the annotated check output. Tests updated to simulate a transient failure and verify retry behavior.
Riley Chen: The initial gating thresholds felt a little strict for some subjective metrics. Recommend conservative defaults and a clear override path. Also suggest logging metric sampling counts.
Asha Patel (author): Lowered default deltas for subjective metrics and added sampling_count to the adapter output. Documented override flow in docs/eval/ci-gating.md.
Sofia Martinez: Approve after tests pass. Confirmed the smoke run in a fork and the check annotations look good.

files_summary: Provide a lightweight CI hook, metrics adapter, thresholds config, smoke prompt-set, tests, and documentation to enable prompt-set regression gating in PRs.
notes: This change is non-breaking and gated by repo_allowlist; operational teams should watch eval/regression_check failures for the first week. Follow-up work tracked in ENG-4988 to persist baselines in the metrics service.
